propositions: Plan-review Pass 1 must migrate from its current result shape to execute discovery topology through the S2 shared typed kernel while preserving YAML/BPMN graph, facet packing, model ladder, centrality-derived budget, bounded concurrency, cache warming, container/prerequisite stages, and live cancellation.

Failed local units must not serialize as clean checkpoints; earlier successes must survive, independent work must continue, dependents must skip, and the final verdict must follow the approved failure policy (BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/advisory-only PASS).

The checkpoint key must change when any material, code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependency, or namespace input changes; corrupt and legacy checkpoints must produce zero reuse.
Only content-identical success and resume envelopes must seed checkpoint reuse; failed, cancelled, skipped, and budget-shed units must remain missing and callable on later runs.

The reducer-ignored review journal must store the safe versioned trace with digest-complete success-only envelopes, while review-plan and review-plan --status outputs must retain only their established end-result contracts.

Shadow comparison during migration must verify identical call sets, call order, usage, cache behavior, concurrency behavior, cancellation behavior, and final verdict between legacy and new implementations with no unapproved differences.
